preconditions.description: Attacker needs to be able to call functions that use the uninitialized storage pointer

exploit_hint: The uninitialized storage pointer vulnerability allows an attacker to corrupt contract state by writing to arbitrary storage slots. Call functions that reference the uninitialized storage variable to potentially overwrite critical state variables like _owner, _adminWalletAddress, or balance mappings. This could lead to ownership takeover or unauthorized fund access. Test by calling transfer functions or owner-restricted functions to observe state corruption patterns.
